## About
SCW Performance runs a retail performance shop and a JDM right hand drive auto dealership in Carrollton, serving folks from Dallas, Plano, Denton, Irving and all around the DFW area. We stock hard to find performance parts, accessories, JDM wheels and fabrication supplies, with a lot of focus on Honda, Acura, Nissan and Toyota.
We also bring in classic Japanese vehicles for sale. Vehicle showings are by appointment only, so give us a call before you head over. You'll find us next to Lumber Liquidators, on the side facing Broadway Street, at the far end of the building on the left.
We're rated 4.1 from 144 Google reviews.

## Services
- Performance parts, accessories and JDM wheels: Engine, drivetrain, cooling, brakes, suspension, interior, exterior and aero parts, plus JDM wheels and fabrication supplies.
- Imported Japanese classic vehicles: Imported Japanese classic vehicles for sale. Call ahead before you visit.
- Services to prepare a vehicle for its new owner: A variety of services at additional cost. Ask for a quote at the time of purchase.

## FAQ
Q: Is it legal to drive a right hand drive car in the USA?
A: Yes. You can legally drive right hand drive vehicles in all 50 states.

Q: Do you offer financing on your JDM vehicles?
A: Yes, we offer financing on our vehicles. It's a specialty loan, so it isn't the easiest to qualify for. Ask us about the requirements.
